official_materials.relevance: The EULA text includes installation/use rights and general scope restrictions, including restrictions on sharing, publishing, renting or leasing the software and on providing it as a standalone or combined offering. This is not a DLL-by-DLL provenance record.

official_materials.relevance: The license describes Distributable Code and refers to the REDIST.TXT list; it conditions distribution on listed code and additional requirements, including adding significant primary functionality and distributing included setup code unmodified as part of setup.
